script: Germany once secretly asked Mexico to invade the United States, and Britain read the message before America even knew it existed. In 1917, German foreign minister Arthur Zimmermann sent a coded telegram offering Mexico help reclaiming Texas, New Mexico, and Arizona if it joined the war against the US. British codebreakers intercepted and decrypted it within weeks, but stayed silent at first to hide that they were reading German codes at all. They eventually leaked it to the Americans through a clever cover story, claiming it came from a different source entirely. When US newspapers published the telegram, most Americans assumed it was British propaganda, a fake designed to drag the country into war. Then Zimmermann himself publicly confirmed it was real, in a press conference weeks later. That confirmation helped push a reluctant United States straight into World War One. Germany once asked Mexico to invade the US, and its own foreign minister admitted it to the world.

title: Germany Once Asked Mexico to Invade the United States
description:
In 1917, Germany secretly asked Mexico to invade the US and take back Texas, New Mexico, and Arizona. Britain intercepted it first, then Germany's own foreign minister confirmed it was real.

Did you know this pushed the US into WWI? Let me know in the comments.
